sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Leadership is concentrated in defensive and commodity-linked sectors, with Energy and Healthcare dominating momentum while cyclical groups deteriorate.

Market breadth remains narrow as only 3 of 11 sectors maintain all-green performance profiles across short- and long-term windows. Leadership is firmly anchored by Energy and Healthcare, both posting identical top-tier momentum scores of 0.883, accompanied by steady gains in Consumer Defensive. 

Rotation favors defensives as cyclicals fade. Basic Materials, Industrials, and Communication Services experienced the sharpest declines over the past five sessions, each falling 2 rank spots. Meanwhile, Utilities, Communication Services, and Industrials occupy the bottom tier of overall momentum.

## Strength
- Only 3 of 11 groups are all-green across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD periods: Energy (0.88 momentum), Healthcare (0.88 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.75 momentum).
- Energy and Healthcare represent sustained strength, consistently placing in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows.
- Energy holds the #1 overall YTD rank with a leading 0.883 momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- Healthcare led all gainers, jumping 3 spots over the last five sessions to reach rank 3 with a 0.88 momentum score.
- Basic Materials (momentum 0.43, rank 5), Communication Services (momentum 0.27, rank 9), and Industrials (momentum 0.28, rank 6) declined the most, each dropping 2 spots over five sessions.
- Momentum remains highly skewed, topped by Energy (0.883) and Healthcare (0.883), and weighed down by Utilities (0.200) and Communication Services (0.267).

## Divergences
- Technology maintains a high YTD rank (#2) but exhibits a middling momentum score of 0.567, trailing the top three leaders by a wide margin.
- Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom of the board at rank 11 despite carrying a momentum score of 0.400, higher than four sectors ranked above it (Utilities, Communication Services, Industrials, and Real Estate).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare and travel-exposed groups are surging alongside sustained energy leadership, while cyclicals, tech, and alternative energy face sharp multi-session pullbacks.

Market breadth shows 28 of 144 industries holding all-green status, anchored by enduring strength across traditional energy (Oil & Gas Integrated, Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, and Oil & Gas E&P) and healthcare (Medical Distribution, Health Information Services). In the near term, rotation favors defensive and re-opening plays: Drug Manufacturers - General jumped 19 spots to rank 38, Lodging gained 17 spots to rank 29, and Healthcare Plans climbed 15 spots to rank 17. 

Conversely, industrials and tech hardware are deteriorating quickly. Engineering & Construction plummeted 34 spots to rank 62 with a weak 0.24 momentum score, while Software - Infrastructure and Internet Content & Information suffered steep weekly drops. Bottom-tier laggards remain deeply entrenched in the clean energy complex, where Solar and Utilities - Renewable continue to hover near the absolute bottom of the rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 28 of 144 groups maintain positive returns across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD), led by REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.90), Oil & Gas Integrated (0.89), and Medical Distribution (0.89).
- **Persistent Energy Domination:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holds the #1 YTD rank (momentum 0.865), with Oil & Gas Integrated at YTD rank 4 (momentum 0.893); both show sustained top-36 placement across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Defensive Durability:** Non-energy sustained leaders include Health Information Services (momentum 0.85), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.85), Beverages - Non-Alcoholic, and Department Stores.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Rank Gainers:** Drug Manufacturers - General led 5-day movers (+19 spots to rank 38, momentum 0.83), followed by Lodging (+17 spots to rank 29, momentum 0.87), Biotechnology (+16 spots to rank 42, momentum 0.70), and Insurance Brokers (+16 spots to rank 102, momentum 0.63).
- **Severe De-rankings:** Engineering & Construction dropped 34 spots to rank 62 (momentum 0.24), Coking Coal dropped 27 spots to rank 118 (momentum 0.24), and Internet Content & Information fell 23 spots to rank 74 (momentum 0.46).
- **Momentum Extremes:** Top momentum resides with REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.901) and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.893), while Solar (0.052, rank 140), Uranium (0.061, rank 128), and Advertising Agencies (0.084, rank 144) remain bottom laggards.

## Divergences
- **Fading Tech & High-Momentum Groups:** Software - Infrastructure displays negative divergence, sliding 19 spots over 5 days despite a 0.60 momentum score; similarly, Shell Companies (momentum 0.68) dropped 10 spots, and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.69) slipped 3 spots.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Home Improvement Retail gained 9 spots in 5 days despite a muted 0.44 momentum score, while Lumber & Wood Production (+7 spots, 0.49 momentum) and Auto Parts (+6 spots, 0.38 momentum) are showing early signs of bottoming rank jumps.
